candidate_schedulers.codegen_rationale: Reserves CPU headroom (default 1 core) for potential critical releases before admitting low-criticality agent nodes. Critical (high) nodes are always scheduled first with full resource demand, ensuring they have priority. Agent nodes are only admitted if they fit within the remaining capacity after subtracting the reserved CPU headroom, preventing them from monopolizing CPU resources and starving critical tasks of compute.
constraints_satisfied: Scheduler must allocate only resources that fit within remaining observation.available_resources
Scheduler must express explicit allocated_resources for every selected node
Scheduler uses only allowed imports and API fields
Scheduler does not mutate observation or runnable nodes
Scheduler does not access forbidden systems (network, env, subprocess, etc.)
Scheduler respects resource_demand for requested resources

Consider isolating CPU cores for critical nodes or adjusting the scheduling priority of navigation_algo_node to ensure it can meet its deadlines. Also, review the execution time of image_captioning to reduce its CPU footprint during critical periods.
